faq.lead: Answers about ordering, payment, delivery and your account.
faq.help: Message us on WhatsApp or send an email — we'll help with any product or order question.
faq.body:
## Questions

Q: How do I place an order?
Choose a product, pick a pack size, and tap Add to Cart. When you are ready, open your cart and continue to checkout to enter your delivery details and pay.

Q: What products does {store} offer?
Our online shop covers everyday spices, chilli, masalas, salt and honey. Everything available to order is listed in the shop, with its pack sizes and price.
[Browse all products](/collections/all/)

Q: Which payment methods can I use?
The payment options available for your order are shown at the payment step of checkout, where you can pay securely online.

Q: Do you deliver to my location?
Enter your delivery address at checkout: the delivery options available for that address, with their charges, are shown before you pay. If no option appears, we cannot deliver there yet.

Q: Do I need an account to order?
No. You can check out as a guest. Creating an account lets you see your past orders and saved addresses in one place.
[Create an account](/register/)

Q: How can I track my order?
Sign in and open Account → Orders. Each order shows its status, and shipment tracking details appear there once they are available.
[View my orders](/account/orders/)

Q: How should I store spices?
Keep spices in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, heat and moisture. Close the pack tightly after each use and always use a dry spoon.
